scope: AKMM Chapter 14 (pp. 405-438) and Appendix 14.A (pp. 863-867): real business cycles, the HP filter, SVAR, the core RBC model, extensions, business-cycle accounting and spectral analysis, with the Herglotz theorem, spectral densities and the Kolmogorov isometry (the Hilbert-space form of the spectral representation theorem).
source: Marina Azzimonti, Per Krusell, Alisdair McKay and Toshihiko Mukoyama, Macroeconomics (draft of December 2025), Chapter 14 (Kurt Mitman), with Appendix 14.A
